data.objective: Golang backend engineer with 4 years of experience building high-throughput financial exchange engines, microservices with Echo and gRPC, and distributed caching.

education.school: Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HCMUT)

description: Developed marketplace catalog search and listing ingestion microservices in Go using the Echo framework.
Optimized PostgreSQL query plans and added composite indexes to speed up classified ad searches by 40 %.
Integrated RabbitMQ queues to handle asynchronous image resizing and fraud scanning for user submissions.
Engineered low-latency orderbook matching engines in Go achieving execution latencies under 5 milliseconds.
Designed high-throughput market event broadcasting using NATS JetStream and WebSockets for international traders.
Employed ScyllaDB to persist historical tick data, supporting rapid analytical queries across millions of order entries.
Integrated OpenTelemetry tracing into Go microservices to pinpoint network bottlenecks across distributed microservices.

Implemented rate limiting and polite request throttling to comply with target robots.txt guidelines.
